title: pilosella bauhini subsp. chaunocyma
intro: Pilosella bauhini subsp. chaunocyma, commonly known as False Spleenwort, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Balkans, for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella bauhini subsp. chaunocyma include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
